rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice when something is impossible or very difficult to describe.

example.english: The atmosphere that night was truly indescribable.
example.traditional: 嗰晚嘅氣氛真係形容唔到。
example.jyutping: go2 maan5 ge3 hei3 fan1 zan1 hai6 jing4 jung4 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this more polished wording when describing an experience or quality that words cannot adequately express.

example.traditional: 呢份感動實在難以形容。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gam2 dung6 sat6 zoi6 naan4 ji5 jing4 jung4
